newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste falls on profit-taking, lower payout.
newsitem.headline: Neste falls on profit-taking, lower payout.

text.p: Shares in Finnish oil, chemicals and energy group Neste Oy fell on Friday as investors took profits after recent gains, and on its lower-than-expected dividend for 1996, brokers and analysts said.
At 1340/1140 GMT, Neste traded at 140.00 markka, down 4.50 markka or more than three percent after touching an intra-day low 138.00 markka. Volume was a fair 8.5 million markka.

"Neste's operating earnings were somewhat lower than expected, and its dividend also came in below expectations," one analyst said. But Neste's pre-tax profit beat analysts' median forecasts by a wide margin.
Neste earlier announced a 566 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax, down from 1.36 billion, and a 2.00 markka dividend per share versus 2.40 markka for 1995.
Analysts' median forecast had been for a 410 million markka profit.
Analysts said Neste's earnings were boosted by extraordinary gains and profits from associated companies.
